snippet.title: 'The Moon Sliver' Atmospheric Trailer (2014)
snippet.description:
'The Moon Sliver' is an upcoming narrative-focused exploration/horror game by 'Fingerbones' developer David Szymanski.

View the full press release here - http://videogamepotpourri.blogspot.com/2014/04/press-release-moon-sliver.html

Follow David Szymanski on Twitter here - https://twitter.com/jefequeso
